summary: Frontend auth flows re-tested after fix (GoogleBrowserFlowMount extraction + safeFetch). Bug REPRODUCED and now FIXED: user can register and login end-to-end, RootNavigator redirects to /(tabs). All 11 acceptance criteria in the review request pass. Google button correctly disabled with disclaimer since EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID is empty. Client-side validation (senhas coincidem, min 6 chars) works. critical_code_review_comments: auth-context.tsx clean: safeFetch wraps NetworkError into pt-BR msg, GoogleBrowserFlowMount only mounts when googleAvailable=true (prevents Expo Go Android silent crash). authRequest has proper try/catch that sets authError.
index.tsx and register.tsx disable inputs & button during submit and show ActivityIndicator — good UX.
_layout.tsx RootNavigator segment guard correctly redirects post-auth to /(tabs) and post-logout to /.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 extra test user via UI (ayrton{timestamp}@simbet.com / senha123) to exercise register + duplicate-email flow. Not cleaned up (harmless test data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All auth flows verified on the preview URL (mobile viewport 390x844). The bundle here is the same served to Expo Go so the original 'nothing happens on Criar conta' bug is confirmed fixed. If retesting, note that logout is only reachable via Perfil tab -> Sair (no dedicated testID; use localStorage.clear() as fallback on web).
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (confirmed): expo-auth-session Google.useAuthRequest was being invoked unconditionally at AuthProvider render with an empty webClientId. On Android/Expo Go this throws during hook init, aborting the AuthProvider subtree before loginWithEmail/registerWithEmail were exposed, so onPress of 'Criar conta' resolved to a no-op callback. FIX applied by main agent: (1) moved the hook into GoogleBrowserFlowMount, only mounted when googleConfig.isConfigured === true; (2) safeFetch() converts fetch NetworkError into a pt-BR message; (3) authRequest() try/catch guarantees authError is set on any failure. VERIFICATION: End-to-end register + login + wrong password + duplicate email + validation errors all pass on the preview URL (which shares the Expo Go bundle).
